subject: Private Offer: term options, evidence needed, and PO onboarding for CloudCore pilot
messages:
From: Anna Morales <procurement@cloudcore.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: 2025-05-13T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Private Offer: Term & Evidence requirements for CloudCore pilot

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the platform looks promising. Our procurement team is evaluating the AWS Private Offer route for a pilot. A couple of quick clarifying questions before we tee up legal: 

- Term: we prefer a 6-month pilot with an option to convert to a 12-month annual commit. Is that a supported flow from Marketplace private offers (i.e., can we start as a 6-month PO and then amend to an annual contract)?
- Pricing: can you provide a firm pilot rate (monthly committed $ or hourly equivalent) and the discount/credit structure if we convert to a 12-month commit?
- Buyer approvals: our Sourcing/Finance teams will need to see SOC 2 Type II evidence, data residency guarantees (US only), and sample invoice/activation timeline. What do you typically provide?
- Activation window: once a private offer is accepted in Marketplace, how quickly can capacity/activation happen? We have a May 26 pilot target.

I've attached a short RFP excerpt (RFP_Clarifications.pdf) with our formal evidence checklist. If you could respond by EOD tomorrow, that would keep us on track.

Best,
Anna Morales
Head of Procurement
CloudCore Analytics

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: Anna Morales <procurement@cloudcore.com>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2025-05-13T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private Offer: Term & Evidence requirements for CloudCore pilot

Anna — great to meet you yesterday and thanks for the clear list. Below are the concrete options and what we can provide immediately.

1) Term & conversion path
- Pilot: we can structure a 6-month private-offer (Marketplace PO) that is billed monthly.
- Conversion: we support an amendment path: at month 5 we can provide a conversion private-offer for a 12-month annual commit that preserves the same subscription id and X-account activation. Activation/change is handled via Seller Console and usually completes within 48 hours of buyer signature + PO acceptance.

2) Pricing
- Pilot 6-month (monthly-billed): $12,500/month (baseline pilot rate).
- Annual conversion: if you commit to 12 months up front we can offer a 18% discount vs list (equivalent to $10,250/month).
- Conversion credit: if you start on pilot and convert by month 5, we will apply a prorated credit so you only pay the delta between pilot invoices and the annual commit price for months already invoiced.

3) Evidence & compliance
- SOC 2 Type II: we can share a redacted SOC 2 report and a letter of attestation.
- Data residency: Redwood Private/Hosted deployments support region pinning; for this buyer we can confirm data stored in US regions only and provide a short technical note.
- Invoices & sample activation: attached is our PO template (Redwood_PO_Template.pdf) and I can send a sample invoice.

4) Activation window
- Marketplace private offer acceptance -> activation: 24–72 hours typical for standard entitlements. If you need guaranteed same-day activation we can request rush activation through Seller Support but that requires finance pre-approval.

Next steps I suggest:
- You confirm pilot acceptance (6 months) and we send the private-offer draft.
- I will route a pricing worksheet to Finance (cc'd) to get sign-off on the conversion credit mechanics.

Attaching: Redwood_PO_Template.pdf

Happy to hop on a quick 20-minute call if you want to walk the conversion path in front of your sourcing team.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0179
